title: Hearing on veteran homelessness in New York City
summary: The Council's Committees on Veterans and General Welfare will examine the state of veteran homelessness in New York City, including housing programs, support services and the Borden Avenue Veterans Residence. The hearing follows the Department of Homeless Services' decision not to accept reduced federal funding for Borden Avenue and reports of poor conditions there, including roof leaks and inadequate security. As of 2025 there were 697 homeless veterans in New York City, down from 1,558 in 2015 but up from 482 in 2022.
